domainFacts: Null-to-empty-string normalization in the drift comparison (Start-AccessValidationRunbook.ps1) is intentional design to handle the Dataverse null vs API empty-string discrepancy. Dataverse returns null for unset option-set fields; the external API returns empty string. Normalizing both sides to empty string before comparison prevents false drift alerts on fields that have never been set.

The $script:TokenExpiry is set to 55 minutes from now when an AccessToken is provided to Connect-AAMDataverse. This is a conservative estimate of a caller-supplied token's remaining validity, not a freshly issued token. The 55-minute value is intentional — it provides a safety margin without requiring the caller to specify expiry.

The AAM solution uses Dataverse for persistent storage (baselines, history, violations tables). Direct OData REST calls to Dataverse endpoints with pagination are the correct and expected pattern — this is not legacy code.

The fsi_accessbaselines, fsi_accessviolations, and fsi_accessvalidationhistory are all Dataverse tables belonging to this solution. Schema columns for these tables are documented in docs/dataverse-schema.md.
